# Vendored skill attribution

`SKILL.md` is vendored from [ryanmaule/humanize](https://github.com/ryanmaule/humanize), a fork of [petergyang/no-ai-slop](https://github.com/petergyang/no-ai-slop). The upstream skill is MIT licensed; its license text is preserved in `LICENSE`.

Chance_Blog uses the relevant editing principles through `.github/editorial/CHANCE_BLOG_TEMPLATE.md`. The template adapts them for source-led bilingual reporting and explicitly rejects invented firsthand experience or detector evasion.
